headline: Everest Industries approves standalone and consolidated results for Q2 FY27
hook: September quarter financial results now public
summary: Everest Industries announced its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The board approved these results during its meeting on October 26, 2026, following the recommendation of the audit committee. Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP issued limited review reports for the period. The filings include segment-wise revenue, assets, liabilities, and cash flow statements.
why_it_matters: Q2 earnings data sets baseline for company valuation.

headline: Everest Industries grants 95,000 employee stock options at Rs 460 each
summary: Everest Industries announced that its Nomination and Remuneration Committee approved the grant of 95,000 stock options under its ESOS-2021 scheme on October 22, 2026. These options were issued to identified employees of the company at an exercise price of Rs 460 per option. The disclosure was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. For retail investors, ESOP grants represent routine equity dilution and employee compensation management.
why_it_matters: Minor equity dilution for existing shareholders upon future option exercise
